title: Church Service and Ministry
definition: Church Service and Ministry is the shared labor of believers using God-given gifts to build up the body and serve others in love.
summary: Church Service and Ministry is the active use of gifts, time, strength, and compassion to build up Christ's body.
christFocus: Jesus Christ served His people and equips them to serve one another in His name.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on ministry as shared responsibility among believers. Service may be visible or hidden, organized or informal, but it is offered to Christ by loving His people. It transforms the church from an audience into a working body.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because churches weaken when many receive while few serve. Ministry displays the varied grace of God and keeps love from remaining theoretical. It also honors quiet faithfulness that may never be platformed but is precious to the Lord.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Look for concrete needs around you and take one faithful step. Serve without needing applause, and receive help without shame. Encourage a culture where every member asks, 'How can I build up the body?'
